"'''Shadow'''" was the name given to the trained [[Sleen/Legends|sleen]] owned by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Pammel Tarqus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. "Shadow," Tarqus, and the [[vine cat]] "[[Wraith (vine cat)|Wraith]]" were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Malignant Bog]].
